description: This file defines the ModulesAPI class, which manages module-related endpoints for the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to list, view, and update the configuration status of modules within the application, implementing CRUD endpoint interfaces and containing detailed API documentation annotations.

classes.name: ModulesAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing module configurations in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getModuleService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the ModuleService instance used to retrieve and update module data.

methods.name: getConfigurableModulesArray
methods.description: Returns an array of modules with their enabled/disabled status, incorporating data from the database and OAuth service.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all modules with their current enabled/disabled status.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update the status of modules, affecting configurations and cache invalidation.
